# Lever

> Lever is a flexible, AI-powered talent cloud platform that combines applicant tracking, recruitment marketing, and advanced analytics to help hiring teams attract, evaluate, and hire talent at scale.

Lever provides an integrated suite of recruiting software solutions including LeverTRM (applicant tracking system), AI screening and interview companions, recruitment marketing tools, and advanced analytics. The platform serves organizations of all sizes, from high-volume hiring operations to diversity-focused recruiting initiatives, with extensive integrations across the HR and recruiting ecosystem.

## Key Topics

- LeverTRM
- Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
- AI Screening Companion
- AI Interview Companion
- Recruitment Marketing
- Career Site Builder
- Candidate Texting
- Advanced Analytics
- High-Volume Hiring
- Diversity and Inclusion (DEI)
- Hiring Automation
- Candidate Management
- Employer Branding
- HR Integrations
- Talent Acquisition
